description: Election Commission - Notice under Section 66A (1) Filling of a Vacancy in the office of member of the Horana Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government council (Horana Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new council member to fill a position vacated by resignation, which falls squarely under Elections Gazettes classification.
